title: Cut the Crap: An Economical Communication Pipeline for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Guibin Zhang; Yanwei Yue; Zhixun Li; Sukwon Yun; Guancheng Wan; Kun Wang; Dawei Cheng; Jeffrey Xu Yu; Tianlong Chen

problem_statement.en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) built on dense communication topologies (e.g. complete graphs, multi-round debate) exchange large volumes of redundant messages, inflating token/API cost with little accuracy benefit. The paper asks how to identify and remove this redundant agent-to-agent message passing to obtain a cheaper, more robust communication structure.
problem_statement.zh: 建立於稠密通訊拓撲(例如完全圖、多輪辯論)之上的 LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS),會交換大量冗餘訊息,使 token/API 成本膨脹,卻僅帶來有限的準確度提升。本文探討如何辨識並移除此類冗餘的 agent 對 agent 訊息傳遞,以獲得成本更低且更穩健的通訊結構。

key_innovation.en: AgentPrune models the MAS as a spatial-temporal message-passing graph and trains a low-rank-regularized differentiable mask over its edges, then performs one-shot magnitude pruning of the redundant edges to yield a sparse, token-economical topology that is fixed and reused for the remaining rounds/queries at inference.
key_innovation.zh: AgentPrune 將 MAS 建模為時空訊息傳遞圖,並在其邊上訓練一個具低秩正則化的可微分遮罩 (differentiable mask),隨後對冗餘邊執行一次性 (one-shot) 幅值剪枝 (magnitude pruning),以產生稀疏且 token 節約的拓撲;該拓撲在推論階段固定不變,並於其餘輪次/查詢中重複使用。

baselines_compared: CoT, ComplexCoT, Self-Consistency, Chain, Star, Tree, Complete Graph, Layered Graph, Random Graph, LLM-Blender

key_improvements.en: GSM8K 95.83% vs debate 90.23%; 28.1–72.8% prompt-token cut; MMLU at $5.6 vs $43.7; +0.84 pts on GPTSwarm while cutting 60.6% tokens.
key_improvements.zh: GSM8K 95.83% 對辯論 90.23%;prompt token 減 28.1–72.8%;MMLU 成本 $5.6 對 $43.7;疊加 GPTSwarm 減 60.6% token 且 +0.84 分。

decision_mechanism: Differentiable mask / pruning, Policy gradient / REINFORCE
benchmarks_used: MMLU, GSM8K, MultiArith, SVAMP, AQuA, HumanEval

agent_scenario.en: Multi-agent debate/collaboration over a communication graph. Main configuration = 5 gpt-4 agents (some experiments use gpt-3.5-turbo agents), each defined by Base LLM + Role + State + Plugins, communicating over spatial edges within a round and temporal edges across rounds. Dialogue depth K=2 rounds for math/general reasoning and K=4 for code; generation temperature = 1.0. AgentPrune spatial variants are denoted -C (complete-graph base), -L (layered) and -R (random). General-purpose (not single-domain): evaluated across general reasoning, math, and code. AgentPrune is both a standalone pipeline and a plug-in that sparsifies existing frameworks (AutoGen, GPTSwarm). Notable protocol detail: agents exchange messages only along edges retained after one-shot pruning, so pruned edges eliminate the corresponding prompt tokens.
agent_scenario.zh: 於通訊圖上進行的 multi-agent 辯論/協作。主要設定為 5 個 gpt-4 agent(部分實驗使用 gpt-3.5-turbo agent),每個 agent 由 Base LLM + Role + State + Plugins 定義,並在單一輪次內經由空間邊 (spatial edges) 通訊、跨輪次經由時間邊 (temporal edges) 通訊。對話深度在數學/一般推理任務中為 K=2 輪,在程式碼任務中為 K=4 輪;生成 temperature = 1.0。AgentPrune 的空間變體分別記為 -C(完全圖基底)、-L(分層)與 -R(隨機)。此方法為通用型(非單一領域):於一般推理、數學與程式碼任務上進行評估。AgentPrune 既是獨立的 pipeline,亦是可稀疏化既有框架(AutoGen、GPTSwarm)的 plug-in。值得注意的協定細節:agent 僅沿一次性剪枝後保留的邊交換訊息,因此被剪除的邊即消除對應的 prompt token。
